name: Rajasekar C
title: Data Engineer
summary: Data Engineer with 5+ years building high-volume production data systems, ETL pipelines, and SQL-backed reporting platforms. Experienced in Python, SQL, PL/SQL, PostgreSQL, and Oracle, designing data pipelines and schemas that support batch processing of approximately 50 million records daily, with a focus on data ingestion, data modelling, data quality, and production reliability.

bullets: Built a Flask and Pandas data automation tool that cut Vahan issue resolution from ~30 minutes to under 1 minute, earning the company "Tech Titan" award
Designed and operated ETL data pipelines processing ~50M records/day for batch processing and downstream reporting
Automated MoEngage customer notifications through real-time SQL stored procedures for policy-renewal detection, eliminating redundant alerts
Owned PostgreSQL schema design and DDL versioning in Git, making data model deployments traceable, reviewable, and reproducible
Implemented PII classification and secure credential storage to strengthen data quality and compliant data handling
Delivered ETL pipelines, data ingestion flows, and schemas for the Bima Satrak regulatory reporting service
Resolved 4000+ production data issues, cutting the open backlog from ~600 to under 70
Automated recurring credit-update and Excel-to-database data ingestion with SQL and Pandas, replacing manual runs
Built and maintained Oracle SQL and PL/SQL data solutions, including stored procedures and production reports, for banking and insurance systems
Owned incident response for live production databases, diagnosing root causes and deploying fixes across client data environments
Tuned slow SQL queries and stored procedures to improve database performance under high-usage production workloads
Managed database deployments, maintenance, and recovery for production data systems across client environments
